title: Kth Missing Positive Number
summary: Given an array of positive integers in strictly increasing order and an integer k, return the kth positive integer missing from the array.
statement: Given an array of positive integers in strictly increasing order and an integer k, return the kth positive integer missing from the array.
constraints: arr is strictly increasing and contains positive integers.
Return the kth positive integer absent from arr.
reference_solution:
def kth_missing_positive(arr, k):
 previous=0
 for value in arr:
  gap=value-previous-1
  if k<=gap:return previous+k
  k-=gap;previous=value
 return previous+k

hints: Track the previous present value, beginning at zero.
The gap before value contains value-previous-1 missing positives.
If k falls in that gap, offset from previous; otherwise subtract the gap and continue.
After the array, every subsequent integer is missing, so add the remaining rank.
